sandbox.title: [parity] compat evaluate/parser/compile reject assignment, function definitions and in-expression simplify/derivative/parse calls that mathjs allows

shim-binding.title: [parity] compat create(all) binds narrow shims/typed-surface functions instead of the mathjs-shaped factories (ceil/floor/fix digits, identity(m,n), Unit/Complex/varargs signatures)

fraction-sign.title: [parity] isPositive/isNegative return false for every Fraction (read fraction.js fields s/n that MathTS Fraction does not have)

bn-unit-equal.title: [parity] number:'BigNumber' config: equal/unequal of equivalent Units with BigNumber values is wrong (50cm == 0.5m is false)

bn-native-kernels.title: [parity] number:'BigNumber' config: pow(matrix, n), sylvester and lyap throw because native DenseMatrix/schur kernels accept numbers only

type-collapse.title: [parity] Results collapse to number instead of keeping BigNumber/Fraction (input type and config.number ignored): pinv, bernoulli, unaryPlus, compare

nullish-fraction.title: [parity] nullish(fraction, x) returns a Complex (typed-function conversion picks the Complex signature)

resultset.title: [parity] evaluate('1; 2') returns the last value instead of a ResultSet (block results are unwrapped)

index-assign-resize.title: [parity] Indexed assignment into an empty matrix does not auto-resize (e = []; e[1, 1:2] = [5, 6]; e[2, :] = [7, 8] gives [7, 8])

trig-singular.title: [parity] acoth(0), acsc(0), asec(0) return NaN where mathjs returns the complex/infinite limit

asech-branch.title: [parity] asech(x) for x > 1 returns the conjugate branch (+1.4324i instead of mathjs -1.4324i)

acsch-complex.title: [parity] acsch(Complex) throws 'x.acsch is not a function'

eigs-precision.title: [parity] eigs ignores a numeric precision argument and normalizes eigenvectors (mathjs does not)

config-in-expr.title: [parity] config() is not callable inside expressions ('config' is not a function; its value is [object Object])

ml-multinomial.title: [parity] mathjs 15.3.0: multinomial accepts varargs and zero counts; compat throws

ml-catalan.title: [parity] mathjs 15.3.0: catalan(bigint) returns an exact bigint; compat returns a rounded number

ml-sparse-zero.title: [parity] mathjs 15.3.0: dotPow/dotDivide/divide of a SparseMatrix must evaluate implicit zeros (0^0, 0/0); compat drops them

ml-bigint-guard.title: [parity] mathjs 15.3.0: implicit bigint → number conversion throws out of range; compat silently returns -Infinity

core-classes.title: [parity] Core: error and internal classes not exported by the typed packages (ArgumentsError, DimensionError, IndexError, ResultSet, FibonacciHeap, ImmutableDenseMatrix, Spa)

core-events.title: [parity] Core: no event API (on/off/once/emit) on the typed packages

core-all-docs-expression.title: [parity] Core: no `all`, `docs` or `expression` namespace on the typed packages

core-factories.title: [parity] Core: 261 mathjs create* factories and all 371 *Dependencies bundles exist only in mathts-compat

core-renamed.title: [parity] Core: expression Node classes exported only as factories; lowercase constants (pi, e, tau, phi, i) only as uppercase

transform-map.title: [parity] compat instance.expression.transform is empty (0 of 26) and mathWithTransform has 3 of 315 entries

release-unpublished.title: [parity] Release hygiene: 29 exports on main are missing from published packages with the same version numbers; string(fraction) behavior also changed on main

oracle-pin.title: [parity] compat parity oracle still pinned to mathjs 15.2.0; latest is 15.3.0

untested-names.title: [parity] Test coverage: 12 mathjs instance names have no behavioral parity test (all, chain, create, docs, emit, expression, factory, off, on, once, replacer, reviver)

docs-sandbox-claim.title: [parity] Docs: migration guide says mathjs evaluate is 'sandboxed' like compat; mathjs allows assignment and in-expression calls

tex-units.title: [parity] toTex: unit-named symbols and deg are not typeset like mathjs (\mathrm{cm}, ^\circ)

tex-bool.title: [parity] toTex of logical operators with boolean constants: compat 'true\wedge false', mathjs 'true\wedgefalse' (decide)

fraction-format.title: [parity] Fraction formatting differs: format(fraction(2)) is '2' (mathjs '2/1'); string(fraction(1,3)) is '0.3333333333333333' on main (mathjs '0.(3)')

fn-names.title: [parity] Functions defined in expressions are named 'fn' instead of their declared name

version-string.title: [parity] compat `version` is the compat package version (0.7.25); mathjs reports its own version (decide)

sparse-zeros.title: [parity] SparseMatrix keeps explicit zeros when the values are BigNumber or Unit (density 1 vs mathjs 0.5)

mad-unit.title: [parity] mad(Unit…) returns the result in a different unit (400 um vs mathjs 0.0157 inch)

algo-diffs.title: [parity] schur ordering and solveODE step selection differ from mathjs (both valid; decide)

more-correct.title: [parity] compat is more accurate than mathjs: zeta, symbolicEqual and range('4:10') in BigNumber mode (decide: match vs document)

fraction-cfg-tostring.title: [parity] parse('1/3 + 1/4').toString() under number:'Fraction' prints '1 / 3 + 1 / 4'; mathjs prints '1/1 / 3/1 + 1/1 / 4/1' (decide)

permissive.title: [parity] compat accepts inputs that mathjs rejects (one-argument add/multiply/subtract, extra arguments, trig on Fractions, BigNumber-mode calls)

expm-array.title: [parity] expm(Array) returns an Array; mathjs returns a DenseMatrix

zpk2tf-matrix.title: [parity] zpk2tf with 2-D Matrix arguments gives NaN where mathjs gives Infinity
